articles.title: Bill Gates, businessman, "Success is a lousy teacher. It seduces smart people into thinking they can't lose"
articles.standfirst: The Microsoft cofounder's warning about success remains one of his best-known lessons about complacency and staying grounded.
articles.summary: The Microsoft cofounder's warning about success remains one of his best-known lessons about complacency and staying grounded.
articles.body:
Bill Gates has spent decades associated with business success, technology and wealth, but one of his most enduring messages is a warning about what success can do to people who become too comfortable with it.

"Success is a lousy teacher. It seduces smart people into thinking they can't lose."

The quote appeared in Gates' 1995 book The Road Ahead and has since become one of the statements most closely associated with his approach to business.

Rather than treating success as proof that every decision was correct, Gates ' point is that winning can sometimes make people less cautious, less willing to learn and more likely to underestimate future risks.

Success can create dangerous confidence

The warning is particularly relevant in business, where a company can dominate one period and still fall behind if it assumes the same strategy will always work.

Gates has repeatedly emphasized the importance of learning from problems rather than simply celebrating what has gone right.

"Your most unhappy customers are your greatest source of learning."

That philosophy places criticism and failure at the center of improvement. Instead of seeing complaints only as setbacks, Gates has argued that they can expose weaknesses that successful organizations might otherwise ignore.

He has also stressed the importance of feedback from other people.

"We all need people who will give us feedback. That's how we improve."

Failure can teach more than winning

Gates ' broader message is that success should never be allowed to become a substitute for curiosity or self-criticism.

The danger is particularly acute for talented people, because repeated success can create the belief that intelligence or past achievements will protect them from mistakes.

That is why the original quote remains so effective decades after Gates first used it.

It doesn't dismiss success or ambition. Instead, it warns that success itself can become a weakness if it convinces someone they no longer need to question their decisions.

Gates ' message is ultimately simple: winning can build confidence, but it shouldn't eliminate doubt.

The smartest people and most successful businesses still need criticism, feedback and the willingness to admit when something isn't working.

articles.title: Sydney Sweeney fires up social media with heated response to criticism over her new campaign
articles.standfirst: Novig bet on one of Hollywood’s most eye-catching actresses to make a splash in the sports conversation, but its campaign ended up provoking very different reactions.
articles.summary: Novig bet on one of Hollywood’s most eye-catching actresses to make a splash in the sports conversation, but its campaign ended up provoking very different reactions.
articles.body:
Without a doubt, Novig wanted to make a statement this year while promoting its sportsbook . The platform could have gone with any sports ad to take advantage of the start of a new NFL season and the buzz around other sports, but it decided not to hold back and brought Sydney Sweeney into a campaign that made it clear from the very beginning that it would not exactly be subtle.

Novig knew it wanted to grab attention

The campaign is called Just Sports and has a rather particular concept: taking different sports elements and turning them into part of a production starring Sydney.

The first video was released on Wednesday, September 9 , and it quickly made it clear where Novig was going with the campaign. For about a minute, the actress appears nude while using different sports items to strategically cover her body and speak directly about sports .

And that was when the reactions started.

The campaign was a hit, but it sparked another conversation

For some viewers, the images were simply a visual treat. The production achieved what Novig seemed to be aiming for from the start: making Sydney the center of attention and turning the campaign into something impossible to ignore .

But other people, particularly women connected to the sports world, took the conversation in a very different direction.

The criticism focused on the use of a woman’s image to promote a sports-related platform. For some, the issue was not simply that Sydney appeared nude, but what it represented to put the sexualization of a woman at the center of a campaign in an industry where many women are still fighting for space and recognition for their work.

And that is when the conversation stopped being only about an actress starring in a provocative ad and became criticism of the campaign itself.

Sydney responded in her own way

On Sunday, September 13, Sydney appeared to respond to the criticism by posting a new series of photos on Instagram alongside Just Sports .

The actress appears nude in several of them, although each image uses a different sports element to create the scene. In one, she covers her breasts with footballs; in another, she poses with a tennis racket and ball, while another shows her leaning against a soccer ball .

The shoot also includes a basketball placed on her back, a football near her feet and a tennis ball resting on her legs.

And, of course, social media caught fire all over again. And while this probably was not exactly what the sportsbook wanted to spark, at the very least, it is getting people talking .

articles.title: Dakota Johnson’s possible new love interest has a controversial past that still follows him
articles.standfirst: Dakota Johnson seems to be enjoying being single, but her new closeness with someone has already put another name at the center of the conversation.
articles.summary: Dakota Johnson seems to be enjoying being single, but her new closeness with someone has already put another name at the center of the conversation.
articles.body:
D akota Johnson seems to be enjoying her single life. Just a few weeks ago, she ended her relationship with indie-pop singer Role Model , whose real name is Tucker Pillsbury, and now the actress has been spotted spending time with someone who would be hard to overlook in Hollywood: Machine Gun Kelly . There is no confirmed relationship for now, but the images were enough to spark speculation about a possible new romance.

Dakota is back on the romantic radar

The two were seen together in New York, where Dakota and MGK were spotted getting out of a black SUV before entering Taylor Swift’s apartment in Tribeca, while the singer was out of town.

The encounter drew even more attention because, according to reports that circulated, Dakota and MGK had crossed paths months earlier at Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce’s wedding . In other words, they may not necessarily be two people who had just met.

Dakota appeared dressed completely in black, while MGK wore a jacket with a skeleton on the back . Quite the unusual combination for a potential new couple, but perhaps that is exactly why social media users began wondering whether something could be developing between them.

And yes, on paper, they could make some sense together. Both belong to that side of Hollywood that moves between music, film, fashion and a style that is far from conventional. The detail is that, in MGK’s case, knowing his past changes the conversation a little.

Dakota’s new love interest comes with baggage

Machine Gun Kelly, whose real name is Colson Baker , first built his career in hip-hop before making a shift toward pop-punk, rock and eventually other sounds. That transformation made him even more visible, but it also sparked several public disputes.

His name became particularly tied to one of the most memorable rivalries of his career: the one he had with Eminem . It began years earlier after MGK made an inappropriate comment about the rapper’s daughter, Hailie, when she was 16 . Years later, the feud gained momentum again in 2018, when Eminem attacked him on Kamikaze and MGK responded with Rap Devil. Eminem answered with Killshot, turning the feud into one of the most talked-about episodes of both artists’ careers.

But that is not the only reason his name tends to return to some of the internet’s more uncomfortable conversations.

There are comments social media hasn’t forgotten

In 2022, old videos and posts attributed to MGK from around 2013 resurfaced, including comments involving women and Kendall Jenner, who was 17 at the time .

The reaction was particularly strong because MGK’s comment about Jenner was once again used to question the way he had publicly spoken about young women. Artist Alice Glass also publicly criticized some of those comments, describing certain statements as disturbing.

This is one of the more delicate parts of his history: the point is not to present the criticism as something separate from what actually happened , but to understand why certain old comments continue to resurface whenever MGK becomes the center of a media conversation.

And now his name is appearing for an entirely different reason: Dakota Johnson.

He also had his own war with the rock world

MGK’s transition from rap to pop-punk was not exactly a smooth one, either. His arrival in the rock world drew criticism from people who felt he had switched genres for convenience or did not truly belong in the scene.

One of the best-known clashes was with Corey Taylor, the lead singer of Slipknot . After Taylor made comments about artists who move into rock after failing to find the same success in another genre, MGK publicly responded by criticizing the musician. The exchange eventually became another of the disputes surrounding his artistic transformation.

Even outside music, his temper has led to uncomfortable moments. In 2021, he had an altercation with Conor McGregor on the red carpet at the MTV Video Music Awards , where the two exchanged words before event security stepped in.

These are very different episodes, but together they help explain why MGK would not exactly enter a potential new relationship with the simplest of public images.

And then there’s Megan Fox

Before Dakota entered the picture, MGK’s name was inevitably tied to Megan Fox for years.

The relationship began in 2020 and quickly became one of Hollywood’s most closely watched couples. Their engagement, public statements and the very particular way they spoke about their relationship meant that every change between them drew media attention.

The relationship went through several crises and eventually ended as a romantic partnership, although the two remain connected as the parents of a daughter they share.

articles.title: Hayden Panettiere death investigation: Authorities reportedly examining possible source of drugs as toxicology results remain pending
articles.standfirst: Multiple agencies are continuing to investigate the actress’s death, while officials await toxicology findings that could provide answers about what happened
articles.summary: Multiple agencies are continuing to investigate the actress’s death, while officials await toxicology findings that could provide answers about what happened
articles.body:
Authorities are continuing to investigate the death of actress Hayden Panettiere , with reports indicating that federal and local law enforcement agencies are examining the circumstances surrounding her final days while awaiting official toxicology results.

According to TMZ, investigators are exploring several possibilities related to Panettiere’s death, including whether any substances she may have taken contained fentanyl.

However, officials have not publicly confirmed a cause of death, and toxicology findings remain pending.

The report states that investigators from the Drug Enforcement Administration (DEA) in both Los Angeles and South Carolina are involved in the inquiry alongside local law enforcement agencies.

Their work reportedly includes examining Panettiere’s recent activities and determining whether any illegal substances may have been involved.

Law enforcement sources cited by TMZ cautioned that any conclusions remain preliminary until laboratory testing is completed. At present, no official determination regarding the actress’s cause of death has been announced.

Panettiere , known for her roles in Heroes, Nashville and several major film projects, had been a familiar figure in American entertainment for more than two decades.

She also spoke publicly over the years about personal challenges, including struggles with addiction and mental health, using her platform to encourage conversations about recovery and treatment.

Reports indicate that emergency responders were called after Panettiere was found unresponsive at a condominium in South Carolina, where she had been staying with boyfriend Brian Hickerson . TMZ reported that Hickerson administered Narcan before paramedics arrived, but efforts to revive her were unsuccessful.

Fentanyl remains a major focus in overdose investigations

The mention of fentanyl in the investigation reflects a broader issue that has affected communities across the United States in recent years.

According to the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, synthetic opioids, particularly fentanyl, have become a leading factor in overdose deaths nationwide.

Because fentanyl is extremely potent and can sometimes be found in counterfeit pills or other illegal substances, investigators frequently examine its possible involvement when overdose deaths occur.

Federal authorities have previously pursued criminal cases against individuals accused of supplying drugs that later proved fatal. One of the most widely known examples involved rapper Mac Miller , whose death led to prosecutions connected to the distribution of counterfeit pills containing fentanyl.

While comparisons to earlier cases have been made in media reports, investigators in Panettiere’s case have not publicly announced any charges or identified any suspects.

For now, many questions remain unanswered. The final toxicology report is expected to play a crucial role in determining exactly what happened and whether any additional legal action will follow.

Until those results are released, officials have emphasized that the investigation remains active and that any theories regarding the actress’s death should be treated as unconfirmed.

Panettiere’s death has prompted an outpouring of tributes from fans and colleagues who remember her contributions to film and television, while also renewing discussions about addiction, recovery and the continuing dangers posed by counterfeit pills and illicit substances in the United States.

articles.title: 'Kierkegaard, philosopher: "The tyrant dies and his reign ends; the martyr dies and his reign begins"'
articles.standfirst: Søren Kierkegaard devoted his life to the analysis of faith, morality, and human existence. He is considered the father of existentialism for his revolutionary ideas about individual freedom
articles.summary: Søren Kierkegaard devoted his life to the analysis of faith, morality, and human existence. He is considered the father of existentialism for his revolutionary ideas about individual freedom
articles.body:
Born in Copenhagen in 1813, Kierkegaard studied Theology and Philosophy at the local university . He used the family inheritance to pay for his education and finance the publication of his first literary works. His academic training profoundly shaped the course of his writings and research.

Throughout his career, he wrote under various pseudonyms to present multiple perspectives on life . This creative strategy allowed him to question both the philosophical doctrines of his time and the rigidity of the Church. His direct style sought to stir the consciences of his readers.

articles.title: Women's sports lash out at Sydney Sweeney: "It is disrespectful to sexualize bodies for an advertisement"
articles.standfirst: The actress appears nude in an advertising campaign for a sports betting company
articles.summary: The actress appears nude in an advertising campaign for a sports betting company
articles.body:
Sydney Sweeney , the actress who rose to fame after her role in the series "Euphoria" and who recently has starred in the film adaptation of the best seller "The Housemaid" , has become the target of numerous female athletes who have criticized her advertising campaign for a betting company. In it, Sweeney appears naked with very little clothing while pretending to practice various sports. '

'Former Olympic swimmer Ariarne Titmus was blunt on her social media about the sexualization of women's sport: "I can't describe the anger I feel seeing this. It is not only a slap in the face to all the women who have dedicated their lives to perfecting their craft, but to all the women who enjoy sport for what it really is : teamwork, friendship, dedication, excellence… I thought this kind of "absurd" marketing was a thing of the past". '

American gymnast Gracie Kramer went a step further and posted a video on her social media in which she sent a message to Sydney Sweeney : This is what a woman in sports looks like." The video was quickly met with a response from other female athletes who included their own videos training or competing with other messages. This was the case of triathlete Jenna Gwinn: "A woman's place in the sports industry is as an athlete, reporter, coach.... Not sexualizing bodies for a sports betting ad aimed at men . Women belong in the sports industry without being sexualized".

Australian Olympic swimmer Lani Pallister, Olympic gold medalist at Paris 2024 in the 4x200 relay, shared another video with her training, races, and medals with the message: "I don't know what Sydney thinks about sport, but this is what sport looks like."

The Australian water polo player Tilly Kearns, an Olympic silver medalist in Paris 2024, went further . She wrote "I absolutely hate the new Sydney Sweeney sports ad" over a video showing footage from her matches.

There is a big difference between looking ‘sexy’ because you play sports and using sex to sell ‘sports

World boxing champion Skye Nicolson pointed out that "giving the advertising campaign exactly what they wanted, but honestly these companies need to do better. Stop sexualizing women in sport". Her message echoed one she had posted earlier: "There is a big difference between looking ‘sexy’ because you play sports and using sex to sell ‘sport’. [...] It is disrespectful to female athletes who dedicate their lives to sport and to the women who have broken barriers for generations, only to then mock it by using a sex symbol with suggestive language and imagery in an ad about sport".

This ad is honestly infuriating. Seeing women’s sports once again being commercialized through the male gaze feels like a huge step backward. We shouldn’t have to take our clothes off to convince men that women belong in sports or that we’re only worth watching if we show enough skin , commented Mexican gymnast Natalia Escalera.

Sydney Sweeney's response to the criticism

Sydney Sweeney also used her social media to respond to these comments. The actress filled her Instagram stories with photos of covers featuring renowned athletes who posed nude for various reports. Among those images were Serena Williams, Ronda Rousey, Megan Rapinoe, Myles Garrett...

articles.title: Ester Expósito, Mbappé's girlfriend, responds to the prejudices she faces as an actress
articles.standfirst: She has spoken on Cadena Ser about her new film ‘Enfrentados: Marfil’
articles.summary: She has spoken on Cadena Ser about her new film ‘Enfrentados: Marfil’
articles.body:
Ester Expósito premiered a new film last September 9. After just one week on the Amazon Prime platform, it is already a hit and ranks among the most-watched. A new film that once again puts the spotlight on the Spanish actress.

The woman from Madrid appeared on Cadena Ser’s ‘Hoy por hoy’ program to speak with Aimar Bretos. During the conversation, Expósito looked back on her career and one of the problems in society that she has always spoken out against: prejudice.

Expósito believes that “there comes a point when you have to stop fighting against prejudice and accept that everyone is going to think whatever they want.” “ It’s not your responsibility, nor is it in your hands to control it. You have to let go . For example, I’m still working on how to build my career without thinking about what is expected of me because of how I started,” she confessed to Bretos.

A career that began in theater, but her role as Carla in Netflix’s ‘Élite’ launched her to fame. Since then, her roles and career have continued to grow, leading her to make the leap to international productions. This leap was also reflected in the level of the luxury brands that hire her as their image. Yves Sant Laurent and Dolce&Gabbana have worked with the Spanish actress, aware of her impact on social media.

Ester Expósito: “Reaching the top gives you independence to choose projects”

For the Madrid native, having reached this level of international fame gives her the possibility of being the one who decides her next projects. “Reaching the top gives you more independence and the possibility of choosing . Which is already a privilege and a blessing. Sometimes you have more independence, sometimes less. But if you’re smart, you take advantage of it to use it to gain independence in decision-making and in how you choose your path,” she points out.

articles.title: Scooter Braun congratulates Sydney Sweeney and brings to light her “true romantic relationship”
articles.standfirst: The music executive highlights the Hollywood star's personality
articles.summary: The music executive highlights the Hollywood star's personality
articles.body:
Last weekend, Sydney Sweeney turned 29 and celebrated it alongside her current partner, Scooter Braun , 45. The music executive shared an emotional post on social media, in which he posted photos and videos of the two of them, accompanied by some lovely words in which he praised the actress and expressed his love for the personality of the star of films such as ‘The Housemaid’.

“Happy birthday to the woman who is the exception to all the rules ,” Braun said, noting how Sweeney was able to surprise him from the very first moment and teach him “how life can be lived in a true romantic relationship” .

Scooter Braun's happiness with Sydney Sweeney: “A little giggle can change an entire day”

For the music executive, she has the ability to make him “smile more, laugh louder, live more adventures, and dream big” . “You’ve made the ordinary seem exciting and the future seem like something I eagerly look forward to,” Braun added in his post dedicated to the actress’s 29th birthday.

“A little laugh can change an entire day. And I love how cheesy we can be together, because nothing else matters . There are a million things I could say, but the ones that matter most are only for you. Happy birthday, Syd. Here’s to many more celebrations to come. I love you ,” Braun concluded, thus showing that the love between them is going strong and the relationship seems solidified.

Their relationship began in June 2025, when they met at Jeff Bezos and Lauren Sanchez's wedding in Venice . According to Page Six, the music executive was smitten with the actress and tried to win her over right away. Soon afterward, he had already met Sweeney's parents and, last April, they were seen together publicly at the Stagecoach Music Festival held in Indio, California.

articles.title: Inés García, Lamine Yamal's girlfriend, desperate: "My brain is overwhelmed"
articles.standfirst: The content creator admits that she suffers from anxiety during the days leading up to taking a plane and says that she needs to address this fear
articles.summary: The content creator admits that she suffers from anxiety during the days leading up to taking a plane and says that she needs to address this fear
articles.body:
"I nés García, Lamine Yamal 's girlfriend, has spoken openly about one of the problems that affects her most when she has to travel: her fear of flying . The content creator has explained that, although lately she has been traveling frequently both for work and for leisure, getting on a plane is a situation of enormous anguish for her.

"Lately I've been traveling a lot and you've been seeing it and many times you say to me: " But aren't you afraid of flying , you're not afraid of getting on a plane"," she begins by explaining. Her answer, however, is very different from what those who see her travel regularly might think. " No, no, not fear, it gives me panic, panic ," she admits.

García says that the difficulties begin even before arriving at the airport. As she explains, during the week leading up to a trip she may experience a high level of anxiety at the thought that she will have to take a plane.

"In other words, I'm anxious, my brain is overwhelmed , my whole body hurts, I mean, everything. I can't," she says. The situation gets to the point where simply thinking about the moment of getting on the plane causes her a reaction of anguish.

I think about getting on a plane and I can't

'Despite this fear, the content creator continues to travel because her professional obligations and personal plans mean that she has to use this means of transport. "Obviously, because of things, obviously because of work like this week or for leisure , well, I have to fly and I have to address it because it is a real fear," she explains.'

García also insists that there is a difference between feeling some nervousness when flying and experiencing an intense fear . She believes that people who do not have this problem may not fully understand the anguish it causes for those who do suffer from it.

"The people who are not afraid of flying don't understand it, but the people who are truly afraid, afraid, terrified of flying , understand that it is anguish," she states.

The content creator describes some of the moments during the flight that cause her the most anxiety. Among them, she mentions the sounds of the plane itself, the engine, takeoff, and landing , situations that, as she explains, make the journey especially difficult for her.

"The sound of the plane, the sound of the engine, takeoff, landing, everything is an anguish," she says. Her experience means that she does not find a moment of real calm during the journey: " There is not a single moment when I am relaxed , not a single moment".

Faced with this situation, García believes that the solution lies in addressing that fear and seeking help to learn how to manage it . In fact, she ends her reflection with a proposal aimed at those who share this problem: "So my advice is that we all go to therapy together and that's it ."

articles.title: Wedding bells? Scooter Braun is desperate to marry Sydney Sweeney, the “modern-day Marilyn Monroe”
articles.standfirst: The couple's increasingly public relationship has sparked fresh speculation about their future
articles.summary: The couple's increasingly public relationship has sparked fresh speculation about their future
articles.body:
Scooter Braun reportedly has marriage on his mind when it comes to Sydney Sweeney , with an insider claiming the music executive could propose to the actress within the next six months.

According to the source, Braun sees the Euphoria star as a modern-day Marilyn Monroe and is determined to make their relationship permanent.

While neither Braun nor Sweeney has confirmed the engagement speculation, their increasingly public romance has certainly fueled questions about where the relationship is headed.

“He is trying very hard to marry her,” stated the source. “He is following her and chartering private planes. He’s going to stay focused on her until she marries him.”

Sweeney and Braun were recently spotted together at Rosh Hashanah services at Temple Sholom in Greenwich, Connecticut. An observer claimed the pair sat toward the back of the synagogue, keeping a relatively low profile during the visit.

The appearance came shortly after their romantic European getaway, where photographers captured them kissing aboard a gondola in Venice during the Venice Film Festival.

The Italian city has particular significance for the couple, as it was reportedly where they first met around Jeff Bezos and Lauren Sánchez's wedding in June 2025. After their initial encounter, the pair were later linked romantically, although it took several months for reports of their relationship to become widespread.

Braun's latest birthday tribute has only intensified the speculation. On September 12, he celebrated Sweeney's 29th birthday with a video featuring the couple dancing and kissing in front of an Italian castle. His heartfelt message described Sweeney as the person who unexpectedly showed him what "true partnership" could look like.

“You make me smile harder, laugh louder, adventure more, and dream bigger. You’ve made the ordinary feel exciting and the future feel like something I can’t wait to get to,” wrote Braun.

Sweeney responded publicly with "I love you" and a red heart emoji.

Their romance is becoming increasingly serious

The couple's relationship appears to have developed rapidly since they were first connected in 2025. They eventually made things Instagram official in April 2026, following Braun's appearance with Sweeney at the Euphoria season three premiere.

Braun later discussed their romance during a podcast appearance, describing the relationship as one of the biggest surprises of his life and calling Sweeney kind, generous, smart, genuine and down to earth.

They've also reportedly moved in together, another indication that their relationship has entered a more serious phase. Braun is said to be involved in Sweeney's professional life as well. Reports claim he helped facilitate a meeting with CAA's Kevin Huvane, which ultimately resulted in the actress signing with him.

That combination of romance and business has raised eyebrows, particularly because sources previously suggested Braun's personality could eventually lead him to become more involved in her career. Still, the marriage claims remain speculation for now.

Braun finalized his divorce from Yael Cohen in 2022, while Sweeney ended her engagement to Jonathan Davino in January 2025. If the latest insider prediction proves accurate, the next major chapter in Braun and Sweeney's whirlwind relationship could involve a very public proposal.

articles.title: Taylor Swift, upset with Nikki Glaser for revealing details of her wedding to Travis Kelce
articles.standfirst: The comedian, who identifies as a big Swiftie, said that she attended the wedding and that guests had to hand over their phones, so she spent about 12 hours without access to hers.
articles.summary: The comedian, who identifies as a big Swiftie, said that she attended the wedding and that guests had to hand over their phones, so she spent about 12 hours without access to hers.
articles.body:
Taylor Swift would be upset with Nikki Glaser after the comedian revealed details of the wedding, held last July 3 at Madison Square Garden in New York.

According to a source cited by Mandatory , Swift finds it particularly awkward that Glaser said she barely knew the couple before receiving the invitation.

The revelation that would have made Swift uncomfortable

" Glaser spoke about the event during one of her shows in Las Vegas on September 4. The comedian, a well-known Swift fan, explained that she received the invitation by text message and was surprised because, in her own words, “I don't even know them” . She also said that the guests had to hand over their phones and that she remained without access to her device for about 12 hours.

She also described the celebration as an extraordinary experience and mentioned the presence of numerous celebrities, and this is the point that would have especially upset Swift : the revelation of some invited people who barely knew the couple personally.

The comedian pointed out that she was surprised to be invited by the couple despite not having a close relationship with the singer and the athlete. Some guests attended without a plus-one and some media outlets have noted that the wedding seemed more like a major celebrity event than an intimate gathering of friends and family.

Glaser also shared a rather striking anecdote: since she couldn’t take any souvenir photographs, she was about to take the Travis Kelce figurine that was on top of the wedding cake. According to her account, the Taylor figurine had already disappeared, and she thought about taking Travis’s as a keepsake, although she ultimately did not.

The story adds to other details that have emerged about a wedding designed to limit images and leaks as much as possible, and that despite everything, Taylor and Travis fully enjoyed: “I wish it had lasted even longer”, Kelce said. “It felt like everything happened in the blink of an eye”. For Kelce, the wedding was a night that he and Swift would never forget.

Glaser also mentioned during her show several of the celebrities who were present, including Brad Pitt, Julia Roberts, Jennifer Lopez, Mark Zuckerberg, and Jelly Roll. Her account has made it possible to learn about some scenes from a celebration that the attendees had agreed to keep private.

For now, there is no public statement from Taylor Swift confirming that she is angry with Nikki Glaser. The alleged reaction comes from a source cited by Mandatory based on Robert Shuter's publication. The information, therefore, should be considered a version that has not been officially confirmed.

articles.title: Jennifer Lopez flees marital drama, shows off her new $18 million Hidden Hills ‘Barbie dreamhouse’
articles.standfirst: JLo turns her lavish new estate into a pink-and-white paradise
articles.summary: JLo turns her lavish new estate into a pink-and-white paradise
articles.body:
Jennifer Lopez appears to be embracing a colorful new chapter of her life, and her latest home offers fans a glimpse of the private world she's created for herself following her divorce from Ben Affleck .

The singer and actress has finally given followers a look inside her sprawling Hidden Hills estate, which she purchased for around $18 million in February 2025.

The property became Lopez's new home after her split from Affleck , with extensive renovations reportedly taking place before she moved in earlier this year.

Lopez recently shared several photographs from inside the residence on Instagram, revealing an interior filled with soft colors, elegant furnishings and feminine touches.

In one image, the star posed beside her Steinway piano in a white dress, while another showed her relaxing in her bedroom. Elsewhere, pale pink and beige flowers were arranged throughout the home, while a pink sofa and oversized ottoman piled with art books helped create the glamorous but playful atmosphere.

“When the mood board comes to life,” Lopez wrote alongside the images, adding a lion emoji.

The home has reportedly been designed to reflect Lopez's personal taste, with sources describing it as a “Barbie dreamhouse” filled with pink and white details. It's a major change from the more neutral aesthetic associated with some of her previous properties.

Inside Lopez's lavish Hidden Hills retreat

The New England-inspired estate sits on approximately 2.5 acres in the exclusive Hidden Hills community, an area that's also home to stars including Kim Kardashian and Kylie Jenner.

Privacy appears to have been a major consideration. The fully gated property is surrounded by mature trees, helping shield the backyard from public view. That seclusion gives Lopez plenty of room to enjoy the estate away from the constant attention surrounding her personal life.

The main house reportedly measures around 8,600 square feet and contains five bedrooms and eight bathrooms. It also features a gourmet chef's kitchen, custom home theater and other luxury amenities.

The grounds are equally impressive. There's a guesthouse, pool house, swimming pool with an attached hot tub and extensive equestrian facilities. The latter include a five-stall barn, tack room and private riding arena, making the property particularly unusual even by celebrity real estate standards.

The estate previously belonged to musician John Fogerty , known for classic Creedence Clearwater Revival hits including “Fortunate Son” and “Have You Ever Seen the Rain?”

Lopez has already been seen enjoying the backyard, including during a gathering attended by her teenage twins, Max and Emme , her mother Guadalupe, father David , manager Benny Medina and close friends.

As speculation continues over Lopez's relationship with Affleck , reports have suggested the former couple remain in contact and may be spending more time together. Neither star, however, has confirmed any plans to reconcile.

articles.title: Shakira seems to have a favorite country to end her tour and will bring something special from Colombia
articles.standfirst: The Colombian singer is about to put an end to a huge chapter of her career, but she decided to do it in a very special way.
articles.summary: The Colombian singer is about to put an end to a huge chapter of her career, but she decided to do it in a very special way.
articles.body:
Shakira is just days away from beginning a series of concerts that will carry a different meaning from any other stop on her tour . This time, the chosen stage will not simply be the place where she performs, but also the meeting point between a farewell and a very important part of her roots.

Shakira has already chosen where she wants to say goodbye

The Spanish capital will be Shakira’s only stop in Europe as part of the Las Mujeres Ya No Lloran World Tour and also the place where the tour will officially come to an end. The artist arrived in Spain on September 14 , 2026, just days before beginning a concert residency scheduled to run from September 18 through October 11 .

But Shakira is not arriving in Madrid with only her songs. The artist also wanted to bring something very special with her from Colombia.

Colombia crosses the Atlantic

For the first time in her career, the singer will take an official delegation from the Barranquilla Carnival outside Colombia , on a scale she has never previously presented abroad.

More than 130 folkloric performers, including musicians, directors and dancers from traditional comparsas, will take part in the concerts . The delegation was coordinated and directly funded in partnership with the Barranquilla mayor’s office to be part of this Madrid run.

Why is the Barranquilla Carnival so important?

To understand the significance of the decision, it is important to look at what this celebration represents in Colombia.

The Barranquilla Carnival is one of the country’s most important cultural expressions, bringing together Indigenous, African and Spanish traditions through music, dance and costumes. UNESCO declared it a Masterpiece of the Oral and Intangible Heritage of Humanity .

Bringing it to Madrid for an entire residency takes the presentation to another level. This is not a one-time nod during a single performance, but a presence that will accompany Shakira throughout her 12 dates in the Spanish capital .

articles.title: Designer Bob Mackie, pioneer of celebrities’ ‘naked dresses,’ dies
articles.standfirst: He dressed artists such as Cher, Marilyn Monroe, and Kim Kardashian
articles.summary: He dressed artists such as Cher, Marilyn Monroe, and Kim Kardashian
articles.body:
The world of fashion is in mourning following the loss of one of the industry's most important designers in the last decade and a pioneer who dressed the most international and important celebrities in music and film.

“With great sorrow, we share the news that Mr. Bob Mackie passed away today. He fully lived his 87 years , fulfilling his dream of being a fashion and costume designer, which was all he ever wanted to do. His genius and his extraordinary designs will endure forever, and will continue to bring beauty to this world.” With this message, his official Instagram profile announced the loss of the designer, without identifying the cause of his death or providing further details about the loss.

Bob Mackie (California, 1939) arrived in Hollywood at just 22 years old when he began working as an illustrator at Paramount Studios. During this period of his life, he was the costume designer for ‘The Carol Burnett Show’ , one of the most-watched television programs of the 1960s. That was where a successful career began, one that would only continue to grow. Thanks to his time on this program, he built up a most exclusive client list: Diana Ross, Tina Turner, Dolly Parton, and Madonna.

Bob Mackie: designer of the most viral dresses

His talent led him to leave television studios for the best catwalks and the most important red carpets in the world. Among his best-known creations we find, for example, the ‘revenge dress’ that Cher wore to present an award at the Oscars ceremony in 1986. The design consisted of a very low-waisted skirt that exposed her abdomen, a tiny top that covered only her chest, and large black feathers on her head.

If we move closer to more recent fashion, another of Mackie’s iconic designs went viral when Kim Kardashian w ore it on the red carpet at the Met Gala . The significance of this design is that it is the dress in which Marilyn Monroe sang "Happy Birthday" to President John F. Kennedy in 1962.

articles.title: “A flood of messages about drugs”: DEA investigating Hayden Panettiere's longtime drug dealer as the net closes in
articles.standfirst: Investigators trying to determine who supplied pills to the actress before her death
articles.summary: Investigators trying to determine who supplied pills to the actress before her death
articles.body:
The investigation into Hayden Panettiere ’s death is moving beyond the circumstances in which she was found and toward a longer history of alleged drug purchases that investigators are now trying to reconstruct.

According to reports citing sources with direct knowledge of the case, the Drug Enforcement Administration is examining years of text messages between Panettiere and an alleged drug dealer, with some of those conversations continuing into the week she died.

“There are a slew of messages about drugs,” a source told TMZ. The same source said Panettiere and the alleged dealer were “very specific about purchasing black market pills,” making the messages a potentially significant part of the federal inquiry.

Panettiere , 36, was found unresponsive at an Airbnb in Greenville, South Carolina, on August 16. Emergency responders attempted to revive her, but she was later pronounced dead.

Toxicology results remain critical

Investigators reportedly believe Panettiere may have taken an oxycodone pill contaminated with fentanyl, but that theory has not yet been confirmed by toxicology.

Those results are still pending and are expected to play a central role in determining what substances were in her system and whether investigators can trace them back to a specific source. A representative for Panettiere has stressed that the case remains open.

“The investigation is still ongoing. Law enforcement has not disclosed who they are targeting, but I am told the case is complex. We hope to have more answers soon,” the representative said.

Panettiere had reportedly flown from Los Angeles to South Carolina shortly before her death and was said to have brought several medications with her.

Her boyfriend, Brian Hickerson , later gave police a bag containing medications that belonged to Panettiere . Those pills could prove important if testing determines that any were counterfeit or contained substances other than what they appeared to be.

The reported text messages aren't the only lead being examined. Neighbors at Panettiere ’s West Hollywood residence told TMZ they had seen several people visiting over a period of years, sometimes arriving with small bags and leaving soon after she answered the door.

One man was reportedly seen visiting with a bag during the week Panettiere died, but no publicly identified suspect has been charged in connection with her death.

The DEA’s interest in the text records could prove especially important because digital communications may help investigators establish dates, substances discussed and possible transactions.

Similar evidence has been used in other federal drug investigations involving fatal overdoses, including cases in which authorities sought to identify the source of counterfeit pills containing fentanyl. At this stage, however, Panettiere ’s case remains unresolved.

The messages may provide investigators with a roadmap, but the toxicology results and any evidence linking specific pills to a supplier will likely determine whether the investigation leads to criminal charges.

articles.title: What was happening at Hayden Panettiere's Hollywood home: Neighbors detail years of suspicious drug deliveries before her death
articles.standfirst: New claims shed light on alleged drug deliveries and the investigation into the actress’s final days
articles.summary: New claims shed light on alleged drug deliveries and the investigation into the actress’s final days
articles.body:
Hayden Panettiere’s final months are now being examined through a new lens as investigators look into where the drugs potentially connected to her death came from.

The actress, 36, was found unresponsive at an apartment in Greenville, South Carolina, on August 16 after suffering cardiac arrest. Authorities haven’t determined an official cause or manner of death, with toxicology results still pending.

Attention has increasingly shifted to Southern California, where Panettiere lived. Federal authorities and Los Angeles-area investigators have reportedly questioned several people as they investigate whether she obtained illicit or counterfeit pills from a local supplier.

According to the Los Angeles Times, investigators are particularly interested in reports that she took what was described as counterfeit oxycodone before her death. Such pills can contain fentanyl, sometimes in potentially lethal amounts.

Reports about activity around Panettiere’s Hollywood residence have added another troubling element. People familiar with the neighborhood have alleged that visitors appeared at the actress’s home repeatedly over several years, with some reportedly dropping off bags before immediately leaving.

Two women believed to be in their early 20s and a man in his 30s were allegedly seen making frequent visits beginning around 2021.

One reported delivery occurred shortly before Panettiere’s death. A man was allegedly seen leaving a bag bearing the name “Brian.” There’s no confirmation that the package was intended for Brian Hickerson, Panettiere’s on-and-off boyfriend, or that the contents were connected to illegal drugs.

Investigators examine a possible drug supply chain

The reported neighborhood activity comes as investigators focus on whether Panettiere received drugs through a Southern California dealer.

Recent reporting has said authorities are examining communications that allegedly involved the purchase of black-market medication. Those claims haven’t been publicly established by law enforcement as fact, and the investigation remains ongoing.

The circumstances surrounding Panettiere’s death have also prompted scrutiny of the medication she had with her. According to a Greenville police report, Hickerson showed an officer a bag containing medications Panettiere was taking.

Much of the report was redacted, and authorities haven’t publicly released a complete list of the substances involved.

Paramedics reportedly administered Narcan during efforts to save Panettiere , while dispatch audio referenced a possible overdose.

However, neither development establishes an official cause of death. The Greenville County coroner has said an autopsy found no trauma that contributed to her death, while police initially reported no indication of foul play or suspicious circumstances.

The investigation could ultimately determine whether counterfeit medication played a role and, if so, where it originated.

As authorities continue examining the circumstances, Panettiere’s death remains officially unresolved.

articles.title: Taylor Swift sneaks into the Emmys while accompanying Travis Kelce at the Chiefs' season opener
articles.standfirst: The singer appeared in a pre-recorded sketch alongside Mariska Hargitay in which her possible presence at the gala was joked about.
articles.summary: The singer appeared in a pre-recorded sketch alongside Mariska Hargitay in which her possible presence at the gala was joked about.
articles.body:
Taylor Swift made a surprise appearance during the 2026 Emmy broadcast , but she did not do so from Los Angeles’ Peacock Theater. The singer starred in a pre-recorded sketch alongside Mariska Hargitay, presenter of the 78th edition of the awards, while she was in Kansas City to accompany Travis Kelce at the Chiefs’ season opener.

"The sketch itself revolved around that coincidence. The Law & Order: Special Victims Unit team, gathered around a conference table, tried to decipher a series of clues on a whiteboard that might reveal whether Taylor would make an appearance on television's biggest night, and ended up discovering that she had an impossible scheduling conflict: her husband's game against the Denver Broncos. While the segment was airing on television, Swift was in a suite at Arrowhead Stadium alongside Tom Cruise.

A ‘Law & Order’ case to find Taylor Swift

Hargitay opened the sketch portraying Olivia Benson and launched an investigation to determine whether Swift would attend the Emmys.

The SVU team examined different clues related to the singer, including the number 13, a figure closely associated with Swift, and other references to her career and her circle.

Swift appeared later dressed as a rookie detective and questioned the group’s conclusions. "Guys, this doesn’t add up", she said before warning that the answer could be "in plain sight". The sketch also included references to the Swifties and to her fans’ habit of looking for clues in every detail related to the artist.

And who better to move the investigation forward than Mariska Hargitay? The actress, a friend of Taylor's for years, also had a prominent role in this year's ceremony as host.

"The relationship between the two goes back a long way. Taylor Swift has never hidden her fondness for Law & Order: Special Victims Unit, one of her favorite series. Her admiration for the show even made it home: the singer named one of her cats Olivia Benson, in tribute to the character Hargitay plays in the series.

The crossover between the two allowed Taylor to show off her more comedic side and, at the same time, brought one of the most recognizable characters on American television to the Emmys with Mariska.

The investigation ended up pointing to American football. The characters discovered that the Chiefs and the Broncos were playing while the Emmys were being held, so Swift would have a specific reason not to be in Los Angeles . The singer herself, still in detective mode, then suggested that she could appear in one of the ceremony’s usual pre-recorded sketches.

Swift, in Arrowhead with Tom Cruise

While the sketch was airing on NBC, Swift was in the Arrowhead Stadium suite watching Kelce's first game of the season. The singer shared space with Tom Cruise and the player's parents, Ed and Donna Kelce , were also present.

The game ended with a 31-10 victory for Kansas City. Kelce, in his fourteenth NFL season, also reached a historic milestone: a 59-yard reception allowed him to surpass Jason Witten and move into second place on the all-time receiving yards list among tight ends, with 13,073. Only Tony Gonzalez is ahead of him, having finished his career with 15,127.

The night left Swift in two different places at the same time : her image appeared on the Emmy broadcast alongside Hargitay, while she was live at Arrowhead following Kelce's game.

Novig CEO Jacob Fortinsky said Sweeney was heavily involved in shaping the commercial’s creative direction, including its visuals and messaging.

Speaking at Front Office Sports’ Asset Class conference, Fortinsky described the actress as a major force behind the campaign, saying she was “driving a lot of the visuals and the messaging.”

The advertisement, released ahead of football season, features Sweeney wearing little or no clothing while using sporting equipment to cover herself. During the roughly one-minute commercial, she promotes Novig’s sports-focused prediction market and emphasizes that the company is interested in sports rather than politics, wars or other categories.

According to Novig, the unusual concept was designed to communicate the company’s narrow focus in an attention-grabbing way. Sweeney also reportedly approached the company about collaborating and subsequently became a strategic partner and equity holder, meaning her involvement goes beyond just a celebrity spokesperson.

Fortinsky has defended the decision to work with Sweeney , describing her as someone who understands how to attract attention and generate conversation. He said the company wanted an introduction that felt playful while also presenting Novig as a serious sports platform.

“As a company, we’re hugely supportive of women’s sports,” Fortinsky said. “We never intended to portray female sports.”

Why the campaign has sparked a wider debate

The explanation hasn’t convinced many female athletes, who argue that the commercial sends a very different message from the one Novig intended.

Critics say using Sweeney’s largely nude body as the central visual reinforces the sexualization of women and distracts from the athletic ability and achievements that female competitors have spent years trying to put at the forefront.

British sprinter Amy Hunt criticized the campaign after competing in the 200-meter final at the Ultimate Championship, declaring, “This is what women in sport look like.”

Former UCLA gymnast Gracie Kramer also responded by posting footage of herself competing. Kramer later argued that the controversy goes beyond Sweeney herself, as she said using sexualization to attract men to women’s sports risks reinforcing the very attitudes athletes have been trying to challenge.

Australian water polo player Tilly Kearns and other athletes have also expressed strong opposition to the advertisement. Canadian skier Cassidy Gray described the campaign as particularly troubling given the discrimination and unequal treatment many women and girls continue to encounter in sport.

Sweeney appeared to address the criticism indirectly by sharing images of prominent athletes who had posed nude or semi-nude for ESPN’s Body Issue.

That comparison, however, hasn’t ended the debate, with critics arguing that there’s an important difference between athletes choosing how to present themselves and a commercial using nudity to sell a sports-related product.

The controversy has delivered considerable exposure for Novig, as the campaign has attracted tens of millions of views on Instagram and dramatically increased attention around the relatively young company.

Fortinsky maintains that Sweeney successfully communicated Novig’s sports-only identity. Critics, meanwhile, believe the commercial communicated something else entirely.

Salma Hayek had an early birthday surprise for Jimmy Fallon, but the cake came with one very important Mexican tradition.

In the middle of the show, Salma brought out a birthday cake and introduced Jimmy to “La Mordida.”

The tradition is simple: the birthday person takes a bite directly from the cake, usually with their hands behind their back.

But Jimmy was about to discover the most important part.

As he leaned in for a bite, Salma pushed his face straight into the cake, leaving him completely covered in frosting.

Happy early birthday, Jimmy. Mexican style.

articles.title: Salma Hayek put Jimmy Fallon on the spot with an unexpected compliment
articles.standfirst: What did she say?
articles.summary: What did she say?
articles.body:
Salma Hayek is having one of the best moments of her career, and Jimmy Fallon got to witness it firsthand. The actress appeared on The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon and, as expected, a fun game had to be part of the night.

Salma had the cards stacked in her favor

The moment came during “Seductive, Insulting or Nonsense,” a game in which Salma had to read different phrases in Spanish while Fallon tried to figure out what was behind each one: whether they were seductive, insulting or simply absurd.

Fallon had already admitted on other occasions that he isn't fluent in Spanish, so this time he was clearly at a disadvantage . Salma, on the other hand, was born and raised in Mexico, so she didn't have to figure out the words written on the cards. She also had another advantage: she could play around with the way she delivered each phrase and the interpretation she gave it .

One lettuce was enough to confuse him

The first clue came when Salma read a phrase comparing someone to packaged lettuce, describing them as attractive, delicious and a little dangerous.

Fallon heard that and figured it was probably nonsense. But it wasn't. Salma revealed that it was seductive , and the host's expression made it clear he wasn't prepared for such a pickup line.

And, really, how could calling someone “packaged lettuce” possibly be a compliment?

Fallon thought he had figured out the trick

In another round, a phrase included the words “hot dog.” Fallon thought he recognized the intention and chose the seductive category.

The phrase was about a hot dog that supposedly would keep some flamingos from playing Freeze Tag . It was nonsense, such an unexpected combination that even Fallon's reaction became part of the joke.

They went through several more phrases before reaching one that turned out to be particularly interesting.

The 10,000-point phrase caught him off guard

The final round was worth 10,000 points, giving Fallon even more reason to try to get it right . Salma picked up the card and read the phrase again with complete confidence.

Fallon said it was an insult.

The pickup line compared someone's eyes to an Ikea , saying you could get lost inside them. Fallon's reaction was immediate: he couldn't believe that was the correct answer.

And, really, how could that possibly be “seductive”?

Jimmy lost, and honestly, it didn't come as much of a surprise. Not even Salma's delivery was enough to help him correctly figure out the phrases, but at least the two of them seemed to have a good time.

Salma Hayek has other challenges ahead

This September, Hayek announced her directorial debut with the independent feature Arena , a project she also wrote.

The film will be a romantic drama about forbidden love and a connection with nature. Cara Delevingne and Yura Borisov, who was nominated for an Oscar for Anora, will star in the movie, while production is set to include filming in Quintana Roo and Veracruz. Angelina Jolie, Stacy Perskie and José Tamez are attached as producers .

Hayek will also appear in theaters with Without Blood, a film directed by Angelina Jolie in which she stars alongside Demián Bichir and Juan Minujín. The story is based on Alessandro Baricco's Without Blood and explores the wounds left by war, revenge, guilt and the possibility of finding reconciliation .

articles.title: Kim Kardashian awarded $1.15 in damages after the theft of jewelry worth 10 million dollars in 2016
articles.standfirst: When she suffered one of the most traumatic experiences of her life
articles.summary: When she suffered one of the most traumatic experiences of her life
articles.body:
The end of one of the most painful chapters Kim Kardashian has lived through . The celebrity suffered a violent robbery ten years ago in the French city of Paris and the trial has concluded with a striking compensation.

Kim was in France when she was bound by two thieves, who broke into her room dressed as police officers, using zip ties and adhesive tape.

Then, the thieves, who were part of a much larger network, took from Kim a series of jewels valued at 10 million dollars, including a four-million-dollar engagement ring given by rapper Kanye West.

The thieves , eight people of whom six were between 60 and 70 years old, were identified and brought to trial, but some of the stolen jewelry was not recovered by Kardashian. They are accused of crimes such as armed robbery, kidnapping, membership in a criminal gang, and other charges.

Kim Kardashian feels relieved to be able to close a painful chapter of her life

What is certain is that Kim Kardashian has wanted to radically forget the incident, and ten years later the compensation she is going to receive after everything that happened is known, which she describes as “the most terrifying experience of my life ”. The amount she is going to receive is only $1.15, an amount requested by Kardashian herself.

“ The experience was deeply traumatic and its impact has stayed with us to this day. Today’s decision is not about compensation, but about responsibility and recognition. We thank the Court and everyone who supported us throughout this process , and we now hope to move forward and continue with our recovery,” the celebrity said in the statement, while also expressing gratitude at all times to the French authorities.

articles.title: Who are Matilde and María Neiva, the twins who went viral during the World Cup and are now signing with Mimoa?
articles.standfirst: The Portuguese sisters caught everyone's attention after being spotted in the stands during the Portugal-Colombia match. Matilde, Francisco Conceição's partner, and María have now made the leap into the fashion world through Georgina Rodríguez's brand.
articles.summary: The Portuguese sisters caught everyone's attention after being spotted in the stands during the Portugal-Colombia match. Matilde, Francisco Conceição's partner, and María have now made the leap into the fashion world through Georgina Rodríguez's brand.
articles.body:
M atilde and María Neiva went from being two fans caught on camera during the 2026 World Cup to becoming the new faces of Mimoa, Georgina Rodríguez’s sportswear brand. The Portuguese twins caught the public’s attention after appearing in the stands during the Portugal-Colombia match and are now part of the brand’s campaign.

Their appearance at the event sparked curiosity and led several Portuguese media outlets to identify the two sisters. They are now part of the “ Your Flow” campaign, Mimoa’s new collection, which is set to unveil its third release on September 16.

The twins who appeared at the Portugal-Colombia game

One was wearing a white T-shirt, and the other was wearing the European national team's jersey. The twins stole the show in the stands after being caught on camera, just as a scoring opportunity was missed.

The sisters' viral story began in the stands during the Portugal-Colombia match at the 2026 World Cup. The cameras lingered for a few moments on Matilde and María , and it didn't take long for the images to spread across social media and accounts linked to the Portuguese national team.

The physical resemblance between the two also contributed to the buzz. Various Portuguese media outlets began identifying the sisters and publishing information about them after the encounter.

One of the details that also put Matilde in the spotlight was her relationship with Francisco Conceição . The Juventus soccer player is a member of the Portuguese national team and was called up for the match against Colombia.

A few weeks later, their name resurfaced in connection with sports, though this time off the field. According to Portuguese media reports, the twins were featured in the Mimoa campaign and are already appearing in promotional content for the new collection.

The impact of that appearance continued beyond the stands.

Georgina Rodríguez decided to feature Matilde and María in Mimoa’s new campaign . The two appear in the promotional images for “Your Flow,” wearing athletic wear and urban-style outfits. The collaboration is expected to gain even more prominence following the models’ rise to fame as fans of Cristiano Ronaldo’s team.

“Your Flow” will be Mimoa’s third launch and is scheduled to debut on September 16. The Neiva sisters are part of the campaign through which the brand is promoting this new collection.

Their inclusion in the campaign marks the next step for the Neiva sisters following their rise to public prominence. Mimoa now features two influencers who had already generated interest on social media and who will be associated with the launch of its new collection on September 16.

articles.title: How different is what Sydney Sweeney does compared to photos of some athletes? Critic doesn't think it is
articles.standfirst: Sweeney posed naked for a sports-themed shoot with Novig.
articles.summary: Sweeney posed naked for a sports-themed shoot with Novig.
articles.body:
Sydney Sweeney 's controversial Novig campaign has prompted a debate that goes beyond nudity, with critics questioning whether a sports-themed advertisement can be compared with ESPN's The Body Issue, where athletes have posed nude while discussing their careers. The actress shared images from ESPN 's celebrated photographic series after criticism of her campaign, drawing attention to the publication's history of featuring prominent athletes without clothing. The comparison has since become a talking point online.

Launched on September 9, the Novig campaign featured Sweeney posing nude with sporting equipment strategically covering her body. The advertisement repeatedly used the phrase "just sports," a message that became central to the ensuing discussion. Some female athletes and social media users questioned whether the campaign genuinely celebrated sport or instead used a woman's appearance to promote a brand. The criticism placed the advert within a broader conversation about representation.

Sweeney responded by sharing ESPN The Body Issue photographs featuring athletes including Nneka Ogwumike , Serena Williams and Megan Rapinoe on her Instagram Stories. The images offered a comparison with a publication that has regularly explored athletic bodies through nude and semi-nude photography. The discussion soon moved to X.com, formerly, where user Dom Clare questioned why Sweeney' s campaign had attracted criticism when ESPN had incorporated nudity into sports coverage for years. Clare argued that the distinction between the two projects deserved closer examination, raising questions about whether the objections concerned the nudity itself or the commercial purpose of the advertisement.

“ESPN combined sports and nudity for over a decade,” Clare wrote. “So, what is your true issue with the Sydney Sweeney ad? Is it because it’s an ad? Is it because she’s hot? “If it’s mixing sports and nudity that may sexualize female athletes, why didn’t you have an issue with ESPN?” The contrast becomes clearer when looking at Ogwumike 's 2017 appearance in The Body Issue . The Los Angeles Sparks forward had just won her first WNBA championship, giving the photographs a direct connection to her sporting achievements. Ogwumike said she had wanted to participate for years because of the distinguished athletes selected for the issue. She also viewed the experience as an opportunity to reveal a more personal side of herself. The accompanying feature emphasized the physical demands of elite basketball, placing her body within the context of training, competition and athletic performance. That context is central to the distinction being raised by critics. The disagreement is not simply about whether women can pose nude. It also concerns the purpose behind the images, how they are presented and whether the athletes' accomplishments remain central to the story.

Sydney Sweeney next movie: What will actress star in next?

Sweeney 's career has extended well beyond her public image, with performances in Euphoria , The White Lotus and Once Upon a Time in Hollywood earning her critical attention and Primetime Emmy nominations. Her upcoming project includes Sleepy Hollow , a horror feature directed by Lindsey Anderson Beer . Beer has adapted her own novel, Hollow , for the big screen, although details of the film's plot remain under wraps. The novel reimagines Washington Irving' s 1820 short story The Legend of Sleepy Hollow , following Katrina Van Tassel through a dangerous mystery and supernatural love triangle. Its story combines gothic atmosphere with psychological intrigue. The book is scheduled for publication in Fall 2027, while further details about Sony 's film production and its remaining cast have yet to be announced. Sweeney 's involvement adds another genre project to her expanding filmography.

articles.title: Christian Pulisic and country star Megan Moroney spark dating rumors after social media clue
articles.standfirst: Is Moroney dating the USMNT and AC Milan soccer star?
articles.summary: Is Moroney dating the USMNT and AC Milan soccer star?
articles.body:
Country music star Megan Moroney has once again sparked speculation about her relationship status after fans spotted a potential connection to USMNT star Christian Pulisic during her European tour. Moroney shared several pictures from Italy over the weekend, drawing attention from fans who noticed that she appeared to be wearing a shirt similar to one Pulisic wore during a podcast appearance.

The social media clue comes after the pair were reportedly spotted together in Nashville following the USMNT 's disappointing World Cup exit in July. Pulisic visited Broadway and was seen with Moroney in the VIP section at Dierks Bentley's Whiskey Row . The two were photographed smiling and enjoying the music together, adding to previous speculation about a possible relationship. Pulisic and Moroney also follow each other on Instagram. Their connection dates back further. Pulisic previously attended one of Moroney 's performances in Miami with his cousin during her 'Cloud 9' tour, and the trio posed together afterward. Moroney 's potential link to Pulisic comes despite saying earlier this summer that she was single. She explained that being unattached had allowed her to focus on her career while touring. “It's really nice that this is one of the first tours I've been on where I'm not dating anyone," Moroney told Cosmopolitan. "So I literally have no distractions. “And that sounds really silly, but there have been a lot of big moments and fun times that have been ruined by a guy for me. It's nice to just have a clear head.” The singer, who was previously linked to San Francisco 49ers star Nick Bosa , also acknowledged that romance could return to her life once her tour concludes. “There is something about having a crush that's exciting,” Moroney said. “And when my tour wraps up in October, when I'm back from Europe, I'll maybe be on the prowl again. “It'll be cuffing season, but right now, it's been so nice to have my friends and family out [with me] and that not be an aspect of my life that is any sort of problem for me.”

Why did Pulisic fall to bench for AC Milan clash with Benfica?

Pulisic 's return to action had offered AC Milan encouragement after a difficult summer, but the American remained among the substitutes for the Europa League meeting with Benfica . The 27-year-old had made his first appearance of the season against Lazio , entering from the bench and immediately providing an attacking spark as Milan fought back from a 2-0 deficit. His movement helped disrupt Lazio 's defense, while his involvement contributed to the first goal during the comeback. His performance appeared to strengthen his case for a larger role. However, Ruben Amorim opted for a cautious approach against Benfica , with Pulisic again starting on the bench before entering later in the 2-0 defeat. The decision was understandable given Pulisic 's recent injury history. He suffered a microfracture around his tibia during the United States' World Cup campaign before experiencing another setback after returning to Milan training. “He had an injury in the summer, and then in the first training session he took a knock and stopped,” Amorim previously explained. That history helps explain why Pulisic was left unused during Milan 's opening three Serie A matches despite being named in the squad.

The two were photographed smiling and enjoying the music together, adding to previous speculation about a possible relationship. Pulisic and Moroney also follow each other on Instagram. Their connection dates back further. Pulisic previously attended one of Moroney 's performances in Miami with his cousin during her 'Cloud 9' tour, and the trio posed together afterward. Pulisic 's return to action had offered AC Milan encouragement after a difficult summer, but the American remained among the substitutes for the Europa League meeting with Benfica . The 27-year-old had made his first appearance of the season against Lazio , entering from the bench and immediately providing an attacking spark as Milan fought back from a 2-0 deficit. His movement helped disrupt Lazio 's defense, while his involvement contributed to the first goal during the comeback. His performance appeared to strengthen his case for a larger role. However, Ruben Amorim opted for a cautious approach against Benfica , with Pulisic again starting on the bench before entering later in the 2-0 defeat. The decision was understandable given Pulisic 's recent injury history. He suffered a microfracture around his tibia during the United States' World Cup campaign before experiencing another setback after returning to Milan training. “He had an injury in the summer, and then in the first training session he took a knock and stopped,” Amorim previously explained. That history helps explain why Pulisic was left unused during Milan 's opening three Serie A matches despite being named in the squad.

articles.title: Diddy’s own lawyers ask to walk away from his $100 million lawsuit and reveal why
articles.standfirst: The legal team claims months of unpaid bills and silence destroyed the relationship, but Combs tells a very different story
articles.summary: The legal team claims months of unpaid bills and silence destroyed the relationship, but Combs tells a very different story
articles.body:
S ean “Diddy” Combs launched a $100 million defamation lawsuit to defend his name. Now, the attorneys fighting that battle want permission to leave him behind.

Michael Tremonte, a partner at Sher Tremonte LLP , filed a motion asking a federal judge to allow the firm to withdraw from the case. The request has not yet been granted, meaning the lawyers have asked to leave but remain counsel until the court approves it.

According to Tremonte’s declaration, Combs has not paid the firm anything for more than six months and owes a “substantial balance” in legal fees, costs and expenses. The filing does not reveal the amount allegedly owed.

Diddy’s lawyers say communication broke down

Money was not the only alleged problem. Tremonte told the court that representing Combs had become “unreasonably difficult” because of his lack of cooperation and communication. He claimed the music mogul had been unavailable for timely and substantive conversations about the case for more than four months.

Combs rejected that version of events. He said he decided to change attorneys because he believed the firm was overcharging him and accumulating bills he had never approved.

“This is strictly a business matter,” Combs said, arguing that the disagreement concerns disputed charges rather than an inability to pay. Tremonte responded that any suggestion the firm overcharged Combs was “simply false.”

The timing makes the rupture particularly striking. The withdrawal request reportedly arrived only days after a judge handed Combs a partial victory by allowing parts of his defamation case against Nexstar Media and attorney Ariel Mitchell to continue.

Combs originally sued Mitchell, music manager Courtney Burgess and NewsNation operator Nexstar Media in January 2025 over claims that Burgess possessed videos allegedly showing the rapper with celebrities and minors. Combs denied those allegations and accused the defendants of knowingly spreading false information. The lawsuit initially sought $50 million before the demand was increased to $100 million.

The separate dispute is unfolding while Combs serves a 50-month federal prison sentence after being convicted on two counts of transportation for prostitution. He was acquitted of racketeering conspiracy and sex-trafficking charges and is currently scheduled for release on February 5, 2028.

articles.title: Angelina Jolie sends fans into a frenzy at ‘Without Blood’ premiere in New York

articles.body:
Angelina Jolie caused absolute chaos when she arrived in New York for a special screening of her new movie, “Without Blood.”

Fans were jumping with excitement and crowding around the actress hoping to get an autograph as she arrived with her daughter Zahara.

At one point, the excitement became so intense that Jolie could be seen trying to calm the crowd while making her way through the commotion.

And she still stopped to interact with fans who had been waiting for her.

The night celebrated Jolie’s latest work behind the camera. She wrote, directed and produced “Without Blood,” starring Salma Hayek and Demián Bichir.

But outside the theater, there was no question who everyone was there to see.
