articles.title: Tales of Miletus, philosopher: "The most difficult thing is to know ourselves; the easiest is to speak ill of others"'
articles.standfirst: This famous phrase by the thinker is even more relevant today in an increasingly digital world
articles.summary: This famous phrase by the thinker is even more relevant today in an increasingly digital world
articles.body:
No matter how much society evolves, there will always be behaviors and thoughts that remind us that we are still the same human beings now as we were thousands of years ago. The reflections of the great Greek philosophers remind us that man has not changed that much.

In the midst of the digital age and with the proliferation of social media, people's relationships with others have evolved to the point of becoming increasingly less ‘social’ and leading us to think less about others, giving priority to the ego, to what others think about us and how they see us.

As early as the 6th century BC, Thales of Miletus reflected on this human behavior : "The most difficult thing is to know ourselves; the easiest is to speak badly of others." In other words, what matters in this life is knowing who we really are and not thinking about what we want to appear to be in front of others. Not an easy task, since we will always want to please others and fit into a society that moves in groups and where solitude is not well regarded.

What certainly seems like a simple task for Thales of Miletus is speaking ill of others. We have the example now on social media: it doesn’t take us long to criticize what others think, how they dress, how they move,... In short, how they live. Whereas we are not capable of introspection.

Who was Thales of Miletus, one of humanity's great thinkers

The philosopher was born in Miletus, a Greek city located in what is now Turkey and considered one of the great intellectual centers of the world, and he lived between the 7th and 6th centuries BC. If there was one thing that characterized Thales' work, it was that he became one of the first to try to explain the world without resorting to mythology or religion.

articles.title: Kylie Jenner, at the center of criticism over a flight of just 17 minutes: where did she go?
articles.standfirst: The star was questioned on social media over a trip on her private jet between two points in California. An Instagram account estimated that the flight would have cost about US$3,000 and once again sparked the debate over the use of private planes.
articles.summary: The star was questioned on social media over a trip on her private jet between two points in California. An Instagram account estimated that the flight would have cost about US$3,000 and once again sparked the debate over the use of private planes.
articles.body:
"K ylie Jenner is once again at the center of criticism over the use of her private jet. According to a post made on social media, the businesswoman's plane allegedly made a flight of just 17 minutes between Camarillo and Van Nuys, two California localities separated by about 64 kilometers.

The road trip can take around 45 minutes under normal traffic conditions, according to the information released about the route. The difference between the two times was precisely one of the points that generated the most comments among users who questioned the decision to use a private plane for a relatively short distance.

A flight that generated criticism on social media

The information was enough for numerous users to react harshly. Some questioned the impact on the environment, others how that money would work to help address problems in global society, while on the other hand it also received comments in favor.

The post sparked numerous reactions. “Did she really look at a GPS and think that 40-45 minutes by car was too long and save 20-25 minutes by flying?”, wrote one user, who also questioned the environmental impact of this type of travel.

Another comment pointed directly to the difference between the demands placed on the public to reduce their environmental impact and the use of private jets by people with great fortunes. “We’re doomed”, the user said in the message, referring to the short-duration flights.

However, users also appeared who defended the decision. Some offered a different explanation for this type of trip. One user pointed out that private jets can make short flights between nearby airports when they need to reposition to a terminal with availability, even after dropping off their passengers. Another social media user said that they would do the same if they had a private plane.

"The controversy also once again drew attention to Jenner's luxurious plane. The Sun estimated that the jet cost around $72 million and features leather seats, television screens, and built-in footrests.

Jenner has shown on social media part of her recent travels, including one to the Caribbean in which she appeared alongside her friends, dressed in pink Kylie Cosmetics outfits, and her children Stormi and Aire. The images contrasted with the criticism she later received for using her private jet.

Kylie Jenner has not publicly given her version of the alleged flight; the information released comes from external publications and estimates, but it continues to generate controversy in the world of the model and influencer.

articles.title: Shakira lands in Madrid in a historic Dior corset and Versace platforms A message for Gerard Piqué?
articles.standfirst: The Colombian singer arrived at Barajas Airport wearing the iconic "Victim Print" created by John Galliano in 2003, before kicking off her historic series of performances in the capital.
articles.summary: The Colombian singer arrived at Barajas Airport wearing the iconic "Victim Print" created by John Galliano in 2003, before kicking off her historic series of performances in the capital.
articles.body:
Shakira is already in Madrid. The Colombian singer landed in the capital to prepare for the start of her 12-concert residency, and she did so in a vintage Christian Dior ensemble that brings back one of John Galliano 's most recognizable eras at the helm of the French house. The choice, consisting of a corset and trousers, belongs to the Spring-Summer 2003 collection.

The detail that completed the styling was a pair of pink Versace platforms. It is the same footwear that Shakira wore in the music video for Te Felicito, the song she released with Rauw Alejandro in 2022. The combination links an archival piece from the 2000s with a direct reference to a recent stage of her career and a hidden message about the end of her relationship with Gerard Piqué.

A collectible piece from the Galliano era

The central element of her styling was a fitted corset from Christian Dior 's Spring-Summer 2003 collection, designed by John Galliano. The garment features the multicolored graphic print known as "Victim Print", an aesthetic that combines graffiti style with urban typography and elements of the Y2K pop movement trend.

Shakira chose to wear the original total runway look by pairing the bustier with low-rise pants featuring the same graphic pattern. To complete the outfit, the artist wore pink platform sandals by Versace .

The artist completes the ensemble with futuristic-looking sunglasses, creating an image that could perfectly belong to the wardrobe of one of her shows despite it being only her arrival in Madrid.

Shakira returns to Spain to close her Las Mujeres Ya No Lloran World Tour with a 12-date residency in Madrid . The concerts begin this Friday, September 18, and will run until October 11 at the Iberdrola Music venue, in Villaverde.

Shakira's residency arrives in Madrid this week: 12 concerts and a cultural festival at "Macondo Park" . Until next October 11, the artist is expected to gather more than 600,000 people at the Shakira Stadium that has been built in the Villaverde district of the capital. A daily attendance of 55,000 people and 19% international audience is expected.

The first date will be this Friday, September 18. Then the concerts on September 19, 20, 25, 26 and 27, and on October 2, 3, 4, 9, 10 and 11 will follow. The residency also marks Shakira's return to Spain eight years after her previous tour in the country, El Dorado World Tour.

articles.title: The former NFL quarterback who turned down Taylor Swift years before Travis Kelce won her heart: “She wasn't my type”
articles.standfirst: Colin Kaepernick revealed that his mother once encouraged him to ask the popstar out
articles.summary: Colin Kaepernick revealed that his mother once encouraged him to ask the popstar out
articles.body:
C olin Kaepernick ’s mother once envisioned a romance between her son and Taylor Swift , the former quarterback revealed tin his new memoir. The 38-year-old explained that his mother believed he and Swift would have been a good match while he was playing in the NFL, but the quarterback ultimately did not pursue the idea as he explained that Swift simply was not his type.

“When I was in the NFL, she told me that I should ask out Taylor Swift because we would be perfect together,” Kaepernick wrote about his mother, Tessa , in his book, Perilous Fight . He stressed that his comments were not intended as a slight toward Swift, but he nevertheless made his position clear, writing that the now-36-year-old pop star “was not my type.” Kaepernick , who played for the San Francisco 49ers from 2011 through 2016 as a quarterback before eventually leaving the NFL , did not reveal precisely when his mother suggested he pursue Swift . His romantic life was also elsewhere by the time his playing career ended as he was in a relationship with radio host Nessa Diab , with whom he welcomed a child in 2022. His partner later revealed in 2025 that the pair had married years earlier. Meanwhile Swift ’s relationship with Travis Kelce began in the summer of 2023 before the pair became engaged in August 2025 – finally marrying in July the following year at Madison Square Garden . Kaepernick ’s mother’s earlier suggestion a striking footnote in their eventual love story but the memoir goes deeper than the Swift anecdote, using his experiences to discuss how he believes his mother viewed race and relationships while he was growing up. He recalled his mother encouraging him to ask a white classmate named Lindsay to a school dance and Kaepernick contrasted that experience with the reaction after he attended homecoming with a black classmate named Crystal . “When I got the official portrait from that night,” Kaepernick writes. “Featuring me and Crystal posed up in that classic, airbrushed frame, my mother hid it away in the back of a drawer. In her mind, Crystal was just a phase. Lindsay was the kind of girl I should want.”

Did national anthem protest cost Kaepernick his career?

Kaepernick ’s memoir also chronicles the events surrounding the end of his NFL career as he became a national figure in 2016 after kneeling during the national anthem to protest racial injustice and police brutality. After leaving the 49ers , Kaepernick was not signed as a free agent during the 2017 offseason, and his career reached a cold ending as no team ever acquired the veteran quarterback. He later filed a grievance against the league by alleging collusion on the part of the league, before reaching a settlement with the league in 2019 – 12 months prior to the global Black Lives Matter protests. Kaepernick has continued to suggest that he remains capable of playing quarterback and when asked recently about a potential return joked, “We got the cleats by the door. We’ll be out the door.”

articles.title: The Cost of the Controversy: Sydney Sweeney loses hundreds of thousands of Instagram followers after her provocative sports ad
articles.standfirst: The actress’ Novig campaign has sparked debate about how women are portrayed in sports advertising.
articles.summary: The actress’ Novig campaign has sparked debate about how women are portrayed in sports advertising.
articles.body:
Sydney Sween ey has reportedly lost more than 200,000 Instagram followers after appearing in a provocative advertisement for sports prediction market Novig . The reported decline has attracted significant attention online, although it represents less than one percent of her enormous social media following.

The campaign featured Sweeney alongside sports imagery and was designed around confidence, humor and a deliberately provocative concept. According to Variety, which cited Social Blade data, Sweeney gained roughly 50,000 followers during the first three days after the campaign appeared. That growth was followed by a reported loss of 136,848 followers on Sunday and another 68,000 on Monday, according to the same figures. Sweeney had more than 25 million Instagram followers during the period, meaning the reported losses represented only a small portion of her overall audience. The numbers also do not establish that the advertisement itself caused the decline, as follower totals can fluctuate for a variety of reasons. Still, the timing has fueled discussion about the campaign and the response it received from some women in the sports world. Several female athletes criticized what they viewed as the sexualization of women within advertising that was presented against a sports-related backdrop.

Serena Williams’ husband praises strong response to Sweeney

The backlash also drew a response from Alexis Ohanian , the Reddit co-founder and Athlos founder, who said he was pleased that athletes spoke publicly. Ohanian told ESPN that the campaign appeared designed to generate a reaction, while questioning why Sweeney had been positioned within a sports conversation. “What’s so weird is Sydney Sweeney is not an athlete,” Ohanian said, before adding that the advertisement was “clearly designed to evoke a response.” He also expressed frustration with some aspects of the discussion surrounding the campaign and the reaction it generated across social media. And specifically pushed back against comparisons between the Sweeney campaign and ESPN ’s Body Issue , describing the argument as a “false equivalence.” The comparison became part of the wider debate over whether her advertisement should be viewed through the same lens as established sports photography. And the British track and field athlete Amy Hunt was among those who responded directly to the campaign and offered a contrasting message about women in sport. “Sydney Sweeney, this is what women in sport look like,” Hunt said, highlighting the distinction between athletes and celebrity advertising. But Sweeney and her team maintained that the campaign was built around a playful concept and intended to approach the subject with confidence and humor. The reported Instagram figures provide a measurable snapshot of the reaction, but they cannot establish precisely why individual followers chose to leave. But with Sweeney still followed by more than 25 million people, the reported decline represents a relatively small change to her overall audience.

articles.title: Nicole Kidman, a fan of raves in Ibiza: the striking technique she uses so she won't be recognized
articles.standfirst: She explains it in her latest appearance on Jimmy Kimmel's show
articles.summary: She explains it in her latest appearance on Jimmy Kimmel's show
articles.body:
"N icole Kidman is in love with Spain, but specifically with one island: Ibiza , and whenever she can, she goes there as a liberating escape from everyday life. She feels happy there. In the actress’s latest appearance on Jimmy Kimmel’s show , he asked her whether she had gone to the Spanish island, and the host added, asking if she had lost something there. But she made it clear just how in love she is with the place and its nightlife .

The actress was candid in pointing out that what she is most passionate about is going out "dancing". In fact, Kidman admitted that she loves going to raves, but, of course, those massive events where there are so many people that a famous person being there can become stressful because of the stares, requests for photos, and so on... That said, Kidman has a strategy that she has implemented over time and that allows her to go unnoticed.

The technique Kidman uses to blend in

Kidman had it clear. She has her strategies. She has put them into practice and they have worked for her. She goes completely unnoticed and enjoys what she likes most. "I put on glasses. Sometimes I wear a small dark wig to hide myself and then I can simply dance" , she pointed out.

In fact, the artist adapts perfectly to the Spanish schedule. "I have dinner at Spanish time, around 10:30 p.m., and after dinner I go to the club at around one in the morning".

'And she enjoys it until the early hours and even dawn... Kidman feels good because she does what she wants and does everything possible so that no one recognizes her, thereby achieving her main objective. "As long as I'm surrounded by people (her close friends), I'm fine. I need it" , while she boasted about her "modus operandi": "I'm stealthy. I'm good at getting in and out of everywhere without being seen" .'

articles.title: Serious allegations against Kroy Jr., Kim Zolciak's son: Alleged sexual assault and a video featuring a minor family member
articles.standfirst: Kroy Jr. is the son of the former Atlanta Falcons player, Kroy Biermann.
articles.summary: Kroy Jr. is the son of the former Atlanta Falcons player, Kroy Biermann.
articles.body:
The criminal case involving Kim Zolciak 's teenage son has taken another turn, with prosecutors seeking court approval to conduct forensic interviews involving unidentified minors.

Serious allegations surrounding Kroy “KJ” Biermann Jr. have taken another turn, with prosecutors seeking forensic interviews involving unidentified minors as the 15-year-old faces felony sex-crime charges.

According to the court docket, prosecutors filed an emergency motion asking a judge to authorize forensic interviews of “minor children.” The filing does not identify the children or explain what they may know.

The request comes weeks after Kroy Jr. was arrested in Alpharetta, Georgia, on charges including aggravated sodomy and aggravated sexual assault, but the allegations have not been proven in court.

Zolciak has strongly denied the allegations against her son. In a statement released after his arrest, she described them as “reckless and deeply troubling” and said Kroy Jr. categorically denied the accusations.

Zolciak also said her son voluntarily took a polygraph examination and passed it, while an examination found no DNA belonging to him. Those claims have not been independently established through the criminal case.

Forensic interviews are structured conversations conducted by trained professionals, particularly when children may have information relevant to an investigation.

The current filing provides few public details about the request, and at a recent hearing, prosecutors also alleged that Kroy Jr. was already on probation in a separate case.

They further claimed investigators found sexually explicit videos involving another minor on his phone. A judge has since set Kroy Jr. 's bond at $200,000.

Kroy Jr. Biermann also involved in parents’ divorce proceedings

Kroy Jr . also remains at the center of an active juvenile criminal proceeding, while prosecutors continue pursuing information they believe could be relevant to the allegations.

The latest motion has also drawn attention to earlier court records relating to the divorce proceedings between his parents, Zolciak and Kroy Biermann.

In February 2025, his mother sought an emergency hearing involving information connected to a phone belonging to their eldest child, but a large amount of the earlier filing was redacted.

There is currently no confirmation that it is connected to the criminal investigation and there is also no public confirmation that either parent knew about the allegations now raised by prosecutors.

The court will determine whether prosecutors can proceed with the requested forensic interviews. Their motion could provide more information later, but the public docket currently leaves key details about the children undisclosed.

The couple had married in 2011 and later welcomed four children together, and their divorce proceedings remain ongoing.

articles.title: Tom Cruise admits that Taylor Swift knows more about football than he does: “She was teaching me a lesson”
articles.standfirst: The pair watched the Kansas City Chiefs defeat the Denver Broncos in Week 1.
articles.summary: The pair watched the Kansas City Chiefs defeat the Denver Broncos in Week 1.
articles.body:
Tom Cruise has revealed that Taylor Swift was the one giving him a football education during their viral conversation at the Kansas City Chiefs ' season opener at Arrowhead Stadium . Fans were starstruck to see one of the biggest music artists in the world and one of Hollywood ’s juggernauts sharing the booth together as the Chiefs took on the Denver Broncos .

The NFL broadcast captured the pair talking and cheering for Travis Kelce during Monday Night Football game, prompting fans to speculate about what the pair were discussing in the ensuite boxes. Cruise explained that Swift had been telling him how dramatically her football knowledge has improved since getting together with Kelce , including how much she learned from him. And Cruise later went on The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon on Thursday, September 17 and told his host very humbly that the billionaire musical icon, “was schooling me on football.” He said Swift had peppered her husband with football questions when they first met and told him how patient the three-time Super Bowl -winning tight end had been while answering them. Cruise has also addressed speculation surrounding his upcoming black comedy Digger , after fans began theorizing that the movie was secretly a musical, with disappointing news for those ideas. “No, but I think it's a very good idea,” Cruise asked, when quizzed on the format of the film. “I think we should do Digger: The Musical.” Cruise then jokingly danced and sang as Digger Rockwell , the wealthy oil tycoon he plays in the movie and confirmed that the role involved a fat suit, prosthetic bum, wig and other facial prosthetics. Digger , which also stars John Goodman , Riz Ahmed and Sandra Huller , is scheduled to be released in theaters on October 2.

Fans prepare to spot try to spot Swift at Chiefs Week 2 clash

While Swift 's appearance at the Arrowhead drew plenty of attention, Kenneth Walker III delivered one of the night's biggest performances, rushing for 173 yards and two touchdowns in his Chiefs debut. Walker carried 23 times and also caught three passes for 18 yards, helping his new team defeat Denver 31-10 while taking pressure off Patrick Mahomes in his return from a repaired knee injury. Mahomes threw two touchdown passes and added a rushing score, while Kelce made history by moving past Jason Witten into second place on the all-time receiving-yards list for tight ends. Kelce needed 45 yards to pass Witten 's 13,046 career yards and reached the mark with a spectacular 59-yard gain after catching a short pass, breaking a tackle and racing downfield. And Swift could once again become a major part of the attention surrounding the Chiefs when Kansas City return to home turf to face the Indianapolis Colts on Sunday, September 20 as her devoted fans aim to spot her once again.

articles.title: Haley Kalil wins legal battle against her ex-husband Matt and gets lawsuit dismissed: She claimed his enormous penis ruined marriage
articles.standfirst: Matt sued over intimate remarks she made about their marriage during a Twitch livestream.
articles.summary: Matt sued over intimate remarks she made about their marriage during a Twitch livestream.
articles.body:
H aley Kalil has won a major courtroom battle against her ex-husband Matt , with a judge dismissing the former NFL player's lawsuit over intimate comments she made about their failed marriage. The ruling closes the latest chapter in a legal dispute that began after Haley publicly discussed her divorce, including remarks about her former husband’s anatomy and their private life.

A judge ruled Thursday, September 17 , that Haley ’s comments were of “legitimate public concern,” citing her life, marriage and divorce and the public status of both former spouses. The decision followed Matt ’s January lawsuit, in which the former Minnesota Vikings player accused her of “invasive commentary” and said her Twitch livestream had made it harder for him to stay out of the public eye. He alleged that Haley “implied that the size of Plaintiff’s genitalia was a primary factor in the parties’ divorce and claimed that sexual intercourse with Plaintiff would leave her ‘in tears.’” Haley ’s legal team argued that she was speaking about her own experiences and that both former spouses were public figures. The judge agreed the subject had a legitimate public dimension. The court acknowledged that Haley ’s remarks were “certainly crude,” but found they were made while she was “describing the ‘trauma’ she suffered during her marriage.” “In short,” the motion reads. “Haley was discussing her life, not Matt’s, and the law generally protects a person’s speech about herself, even though such speech inevitably reveals details about others.”

Haley reacts to courtroom victory over Matt

Haley made the comments during a Twitch livestream with streamer Marlon Garcia , where the former Sports Illustrated model discussed her nearly seven-year marriage to Matt . He filed his civil suit on January 6 , alleging the livestream brought unwanted attention to him and his family. He said relatives faced continued circulation of what he called deeply personal statements. Haley filed her motion to dismiss on January 23 , asking the court to throw out Matt ’s unjust enrichment and invasion of privacy claims. Her attorneys argued that her comments were protected speech. The judge ultimately dismissed the complaint without needing to resolve Haley ’s additional First Amendment argument. “I am so relieved this is over,” Haley told TMZ. “I never wanted to be in a courtroom discussing matters of my own life. “I think this ruling is important and I hope it encourages women everywhere to speak openly about what they've been through. Your story belongs to you and you shouldn’t fear sharing it.” Matt ’s attorney said the legal team plans to appeal the decision but for now, Haley has emerged victorious.

articles.title: Kim Kardashian opens up about health condition linked to family tragedy
articles.standfirst: The diagnosis has prompted renewed attention to a disorder that can significantly impact a person’s quality of life
articles.summary: The diagnosis has prompted renewed attention to a disorder that can significantly impact a person’s quality of life
articles.body:
K im Kardashian has revealed a new health diagnosis that has sparked concern within her family and revived memories of one of the most difficult chapters in their lives.

In a newly released trailer for Season 8 of The Kardashians, the SKIMS founder disclosed that she has been diagnosed with esophagitis, an inflammatory condition that affects the lining of the esophagus. While the condition is distinct from cancer, the diagnosis immediately struck an emotional chord because Kim’s father, famed attorney Robert Kardashian, died from esophageal cancer in 2003.

“I have something called esophagitis,” Kardashian says in the trailer while having her hair done . The preview then cuts to footage of the reality television star lying in a hospital bed as she undergoes a medical evaluation.

An off-camera voice asks a question that underscores the family’s concern: “Didn’t your father… isn’t it what he died of?” The moment visibly affects Kris Jenner, who struggles to contain her emotions. “I can’t, it makes me want to cry,” Jenner says in the trailer.

Treatment typically depends on the underlying cause

Although the footage does not provide details about the severity of Kardashian’s condition or what may have caused it, the diagnosis has prompted renewed attention to a disorder that can significantly impact a person’s quality of life.

According to the Mayo Clinic, esophagitis is inflammation of the tissue lining the esophagus, the tube that carries food from the mouth to the stomach. The condition can cause painful swallowing, difficulty swallowing, chest pain, and discomfort in the upper digestive tract.

Common causes include acid reflux, infections, allergies, and irritation from certain medications. Treatment typically depends on the underlying cause and the extent of tissue damage. In some cases, untreated esophagitis can lead to complications such as dehydration, unintended weight loss, and narrowing or scarring of the esophagus.

Esophageal cancer and esophagitis are separate conditions

The diagnosis carries emotional significance beyond the medical details. Robert Kardashian , best known for his role as a member of O.J. Simpson’s defense team during the highly publicized murder trial of the 1990s, died at the age of 59 after battling esophageal cancer. His death came just weeks after his diagnosis, a reality that left a lasting impact on his children.

Kim’s sister, Khloé Kardashian, spoke candidly about that experience during an April 2025 episode of her Khloé in Wonder Land podcast. “My dad died really quickly,” Khloé recalled. “He had esophageal cancer and I think he died six or seven weeks after diagnosis.”

She explained that, at the time, she struggled to process both the speed of her father’s decline and the fact that he never fully discussed the terminal nature of his illness with his children. “I need someone to blame, so I’m gonna blame my dad, ’cause he didn’t tell me that it was terminal,” she said while reflecting on the anger and guilt she carried after his death.

Over time, Khloé said she found peace through openly discussing her grief, eventually reaching a point where she could remember her father with admiration rather than sadness. While Kim Kardashian’s diagnosis is not cancer, the connection to the same part of the body that was affected by her father’s illness explains why the news has resonated so strongly within the family.

Esophageal cancer and esophagitis are separate conditions. According to the Cleveland Clinic , esophageal cancer develops when abnormal cells grow uncontrollably within the esophagus and form tumors.

articles.title: Duncan Sheik dies at 56: What was the cause of his death?
articles.standfirst: The news came after several days that had already raised concerns among those who had been following him closely.
articles.summary: The news came after several days that had already raised concerns among those who had been following him closely.
articles.body:
The first sign of concern came on September 16 , when Sheik’s family announced on social media that the musician had been hospitalized in an emergency and was in “critical but stable" condition. The announcement sparked speculation among his followers, especially because there had been no indication that he was dealing with any serious illness.

The following day, September 17, Sheik died at a hospital in Manhattan, New York , surrounded by his loved ones. His family kept the news private for several hours, and it was not until September 18 that his mother, Suzanne Sheik, publicly confirmed his death .

That was also when details about what had happened began to emerge.

The cause of death explains how everything became complicated

Available information about Duncan Sheik’s death indicates that heart failure eventually led to cardiac arrest and, later, organ failure . To understand how the situation reached that point, it is important to separate three conditions that may sound similar but occur differently within the body .

Heart failure means that the heart can no longer pump enough blood to meet the body’s needs. It does not mean that the heart immediately stops, but it does mean that its ability to maintain circulation becomes compromised . If the condition worsens, the rest of the body can begin to suffer as well.

That is where an important distinction comes in. Cardiac arrest occurs when the heart stops pumping blood effectively . When that happens, the brain and other organs stop receiving the oxygen they need, causing the situation to become critical within a very short period of time.

If circulation cannot be maintained, the consequences can spread to other organs. That is when organ failure can occur, meaning that one or more organs begin to stop functioning properly. In Sheik’s case, these complications were connected and continued to worsen, ultimately leading to his death .

articles.title: Theo James has been with the same woman since before Hollywood fame: Who is his wife?
articles.standfirst: Theo James is still with the woman who watched him grow.
articles.summary: Theo James is still with the woman who watched him grow.
articles.body:
T heo James has become one of the most recognizable faces on screen thanks to roles like Four in Divergent and his work in The White Lotus and The Gentlemen . But his personal story began long before audiences started recognizing his name.

She was there before the fame

Theo James and Ruth Kearney met in 2009 , when they were both studying at the Bristol Old Vic Theatre School and still trying to find their place in acting.

At the time, neither of them had the exposure that would come years later. Theo was just starting to land his first roles, while Ruth was also building her own path as an actress.

What began between two young actors who shared the same training eventually became a relationship that carried them through a completely different chapter of their lives. Theo began gaining more and more recognition, but his relationship with Ruth continued to grow away from the spotlight .

And that is one of the most interesting details about their story: Ruth knew Theo before the world knew who he was .

Nearly a decade later, they got married

After several years together, their relationship took another important step. Theo James and Ruth Kearney married on August 25, 2018 , by which point the actor's career had already reached an international level.

Who is Ruth Kearney, Theo James' wife?

Ruth was born in London on November 10, 1984 , although she grew up in Dublin after moving to Ireland when she was five years old. She studied Drama at Trinity College Dublin before attending the Bristol Old Vic Theatre School, where she met Theo .

Throughout her career, she has appeared in shows such as Primeval, where she played Jess Parker, as well as The Following and Flaked. Her face, however, has never had the same level of international exposure as her husband's.

Although their careers took different paths, there was one occasion when they found themselves in front of the cameras together again.

They also shared the screen

In 2019, Ruth appeared in Sanditon as Eliza Campion, while Theo played Sidney Parker .

The coincidence came with a special detail: by then, they had already been together for years and had recently become husband and wife. This time, their paths crossed not at an acting school, but within a completely different story .

After several years together, their relationship took another important step. Theo James and Ruth Kearney married on August 25, 2018 , by which point the actor's career had already reached an international level.
Who is Ruth Kearney, Theo James' wife?

Ruth was born in London on November 10, 1984 , although she grew up in Dublin after moving to Ireland when she was five years old. She studied Drama at Trinity College Dublin before attending the Bristol Old Vic Theatre School, where she met Theo .

Throughout her career, she has appeared in shows such as Primeval, where she played Jess Parker, as well as The Following and Flaked. Her face, however, has never had the same level of international exposure as her husband's.
Although their careers took different paths, there was one occasion when they found themselves in front of the cameras together again.
They also shared the screen
In 2019, Ruth appeared in Sanditon as Eliza Campion, while Theo played Sidney Parker .

The coincidence came with a special detail: by then, they had already been together for years and had recently become husband and wife. This time, their paths crossed not at an acting school, but within a completely different story .

articles.title: A message from Kylian Mbappé's girlfriend, Ester Exposito, "goes viral" after she lashes out against the rumors targeting her
articles.standfirst: Her relationship with Mbappé has led to numerous false reports emerging about the couple, and the actress is denouncing it.
articles.summary: Her relationship with Mbappé has led to numerous false reports emerging about the couple, and the actress is denouncing it.
articles.body:
Ester Expósito is a high-profile actress in Spain and is making her way abroad . Added to all this is the romantic relationship she has with Kylian Mbappé, which has meant greater exposure in every sense , and she herself has noticed it. She has had and still has to live with the abundant information that arises around her, but there is one concept she will not tolerate: fake news . She feels like easy prey and has shown her discomfort about it.

In one of the many reflections she made a few days ago during her visit to the program "Hoy por hoy" on Ser with Aimar Bretos, she really let loose. A rather delicate issue on which she has a well-formed opinion and did not hesitate to speak out about that specific matter. The issue of hoaxes or lies. This has caused it to go viral. A deep reflection. Detailed. Careful , knowing what she was saying and how. The kind that stays with you for continued reflection.

Ester Exposito lamented the hoaxes

"Expósito lamented that hoaxes are "the order of the day... Anyone can say whatever they want, use your image for whatever they want and there are no repercussions, we are very unprotected". And it hurts her.

But then the key moment came. Bretos asked her which rumor about her had hurt her the most. "There have been so many... This summer there were some really nasty ones, but I don't want to get into it. But yes, rumors, information that is completely manipulated in an opportunistic and often misogynistic way, whose aim is to defame and hurt" , she pointed out.

'Her relationship with Mbappé has sparked numerous reactions. "Absurd hoaxes created with the aim of tarnishing a story between two people and hurting my dignity" , recalling that she has been the victim of false infidelity rumors and has been attacked over her romance with the French Real Madrid player.'

'In passing, she also delivered a verdict on this matter to settle it. " Most of the time I let it pass because I can't live denying every single thing; that does not mean in the slightest that it's true . But I want to think that people are not stupid and that we are coming to understand how social media works, how manipulating things sells, and I trust that people do not believe everything they read. This summer I felt like drawing a line," she stated.'

articles.title: Kevin Costner is in a passionate relationship with a 39-year-old influencer from Arizona
articles.standfirst: The "Yellowstone" star has reportedly been spending time with lifestyle influencer McKenna Wesley for around a year
articles.summary: The "Yellowstone" star has reportedly been spending time with lifestyle influencer McKenna Wesley for around a year
articles.body:
K evin Costner 's romantic life has once again become a subject of attention, with the 71-year-old Hollywood star reportedly spending time with Arizona-based lifestyle influencer McKenna Wesley .

According to Page Six, Costner and Wesley have been seeing each other for around a year, although neither has publicly confirmed the nature of their relationship.

The pair were first photographed together in October 2025 at a screening of Costner's classic movie "Field of Dreams" at Scottsdale Stadium in Arizona, Wesley's hometown. Costner hosted the screening after the championship game of the sixth annual Western Wiffle Ball Classic tournament.

The report adds that the two have continued to spend time together since that appearance. A source told Page Six that Wesley has been a guest at Costner's properties in both Santa Barbara and Aspen, while the pair were also reportedly seen having lunch together in Santa Barbara in August.

Another source offered an explanation for how the relationship began, saying, “They met in Scottsdale about a year ago. They both love to golf.”

Wesley , 39, describes herself professionally as a "lifestyle influencer & content creator." Her representative has declined to discuss the relationship publicly.

“McKenna doesn’t wish to comment on her relationship with Mr. Costner.”

Costner's representatives did not respond to Page Six's requests for comment. That means the reported relationship remains based on photographs and claims from sources rather than a public confirmation from either person.

From a Scottsdale meeting to time together in California

The reported connection comes during a period in which Costner's personal life has received renewed attention following his divorce from Christine Baumgartner.

Costner and Baumgartner were married in 2004 after beginning their relationship in the late 1990s. Their divorce was finalized in February 2024 following months of legal proceedings. The former couple share three children and agreed to joint custody as part of their settlement.

Since the end of that marriage, Costner has been linked in reports to several women, including socialite Kelly Noonan Gores . More recently, Page Six reported that he had been seen with 40-year-old lifestyle coach Jennifer Milburn in Santa Barbara.

The pair were described as "extremely affectionate" during a grocery-shopping outing, although neither publicly confirmed a romance.

The Wesley report adds another name to the list of women with whom Costner has been photographed or associated since his divorce.

There is, however, a longer history behind Costner's public romantic life. Before his marriage to Baumgartner, the actor was married to Cindy Silva from 1978 until their divorce in 1994. The former couple share three adult children.

Costner also has a son with Bridget Rooney and has previously been linked romantically to figures including Elle Macpherson and Jewel.

Costner's career, meanwhile, remains closely connected to the Western and sports themes that have apparently featured in his time with Wesley.

His connection to Scottsdale was particularly fitting for the reported first public sighting with Wesley . "Field of Dreams," released in 1989, remains one of Costner's best-known films and centers on baseball, while his later career has included an extensive focus on Western stories.

His role as John Dutton in "Yellowstone" helped establish another major chapter of his career, turning him into one of television's most recognizable leading men.

The actor has also built a lifestyle away from Hollywood. Page Six reports that his Dunbar Ranch in Aspen covers approximately 160 acres and includes private lakes and multiple residences.

He also owns a coastal compound in Carpinteria, California, with ocean views and access to the Pacific coastline.

Those properties have reportedly provided settings for Costner and Wesley to spend time together away from the spotlight. The source's claim that Wesley has visited both residences suggests that their connection has extended beyond a single public appearance in Arizona.

Still, the limited public information means there is no official confirmation of how Costner and Wesley define their relationship.

The timing of the latest report also illustrates how closely Costner's private life is being watched. At 71, the Oscar-winning actor remains a major celebrity, while Wesley has built her own audience through lifestyle and social-media content.

For now, the reported relationship appears to be developing largely away from the cameras. Their shared interest in golf, their Scottsdale connection and their reported meetings in California provide the clearest public clues, while Wesley's representative has chosen not to comment and Costner's representatives have not responded.

If the pair eventually decide to make the relationship public, it would mark another chapter in Costner's life following his high-profile divorce and the renewed attention surrounding his personal relationships.
